decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to remove part of the exisitng structure so that the development to be retained is a detached outbuilding, as shown on unnumbered drawing received 30 September 2003, shall be carried out within three months of the date of this consent, to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the storage building is used.
Condition : 4 - The building shall only be used for storage purposes ancilliary to the residential use of the property.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the storage building hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Retention of single storey building situated one metre from existing rear extension to dwellinghouse.
